recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not revert the value set to 421967003 for FHIR-8062; any future medication form terminology work should start from the later FHIR-19296/FHIR-24700 history.
issue_request: FHIR-8062 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy correction reporting that MedicationForm/medication.product.form linked to route-of-administration value-set content and approving a fix to the correct medication form value set using SNOMED CT descendants of 421967003.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the fix was applied in SVN 6615. Git-svn commit c74b8e3ebbf92ccc157a591a1571158559a655cd is SVN r6615 and changed source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009, the route-of-administration value parent, to 421967003 for the Medication.form value-set expansion fix. The commit is keyed to FHIR-6219/#7262 and duplicates rather than FHIR-8062 specifically, but it matches the seed's reported correction family.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, and the old medication.product.form concept has evolved into Medication.doseForm. The current StructureDefinition binds Medication.doseForm to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-form-codes. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-19296 approved changing the form value-set parent from 421967003 to 736542009 (Pharmaceutical dose form), which is the current source value; FHIR-24700 later treated a 736542009 expansion problem as a tooling/no-change issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source no longer points Medication.doseForm at route-codes or the route-of-administration SNOMED parent, and the remaining difference from the 2015 resolution text is explained by the later FHIR-19296 decision.
